opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be UK‑based organisations; individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK institution are not eligible; projects led by schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD fee projects, establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs, or local charities are excluded.
opportunities.summary: Our Main Grants fund (the Research, Development and Analysis Fund) offers up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications are welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, with grants from £15,000 to £500,000, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse UK.
